response.original_title: Seedz of Revolution: Growing Up New Afrikan
response.overview: This documentary centers the offspring of the Republic of New Afrika, a Black nationalist movement established in 1968 that continues to advocate for an independent Black nation. It explores their multilayered consciousness, identities, and experiences growing up within a revolutionary movement, examining how they inherit, negotiate, and reimagine the revolutionary legacies of their elders and ancestors.
response.title: Seedz of Revolution: Growing Up New Afrikan
